blocks.heading: Skills Decide Who Is Trusted with More
rows: Hard skill, for example SQL, Tally, CAD or Python
Shown by a work sample
The task can be tested and repeated.
Soft skill, for example communication or teamwork
Shown by a specific story and behaviour
It shows up in how you handle people, deadlines and mistakes.
Hard skill alone
Gets interviews, limits growth
You are hired for the task but not trusted with leadership.
Soft skill alone
Pleasant but hard to hire
Employers still need proof you can do the task.

blocks.heading: Common Mix-Ups to Avoid
rows: Treating a certificate as a skill
A certificate shows you attended. A work sample shows you can do it.
Collecting many certificates without projects wastes money.
Listing soft skills as adjectives
A resume line such as "good communicator" proves nothing.
Use a number or a result instead.
Treating soft skills as personality
They are habits and can be practised.
Practice needs feedback from someone else.
